title: Kbd
description: Keyboard keys as small cast pieces: a bottom edge, mono type, nothing else.
usage: In menus, tooltips and empty states to teach shortcuts. Use symbols (⌘ ⇧ ⌥) on Apple platforms, words (Ctrl, Alt) elsewhere.
a11y: Wrap the key in <kbd> so it is announced as keyboard input. A shortcut hint never replaces a visible label for the action itself.
